note: 28 位虛構人物肖像；id 對應 js/data.js 的 people[i].id。性別與年齡依假資料的姓名與身分設定。

items.name: KENJI TAKAMORI
items.prompt: 62-year-old man, design professor. Grey short hair, dark navy jacket over a black crew-neck. Calm, thoughtful expression, looking off to the side. Natural window light from one side. Plain off-white gallery wall background.

items.name: MIO SHIRAKAWA
items.prompt: 21-year-old woman, textile student. Long straight black hair, cream hand-knit sweater. Faint shy smile, looking at the camera. Very high-key soft white light from a snowy window, almost blown-out white background.

items.name: RYOTA OGURA
items.prompt: 32-year-old man, product designer. Short neat black hair, thin metal-frame glasses, plain grey shirt. Friendly closed-mouth smile, facing the camera. Flat office light. Plain white wall background.

items.name: NATSUKI HAYAMA
items.prompt: 22-year-old woman, craft student. Hair tied back, dark work apron over a white T-shirt. Laughing lightly, looking away. Warm afternoon workshop light. Blurred wooden shelves with lacquerware behind her.

items.name: SHUN KITAGAWA
items.prompt: 44-year-old man, graphic design lecturer. Short tousled hair, light stubble, black shirt. Direct serious gaze, head tilted slightly. Half of the background is a white wall and half is a deep black doorway, with a hard vertical edge.

items.name: AYANE MINATO
items.prompt: 33-year-old woman, illustrator. Chin-length bob with blunt bangs, striped navy and white top. Gentle smile. Outdoors on an overcast day. Blurred harbor with pale sea and sky behind her.

items.name: TOMOYA ISHIDA
items.prompt: 23-year-old man, media art student. Messy black hair, dark hoodie. Looking down slightly, lit only by cold blue light from a screen below. Almost black background with a faint blue glow. Strong blue color cast over the whole image.

items.name: YUKA FUJINO
items.prompt: 58-year-old woman, metalwork professor. Short grey hair, simple dark smock. Composed, faint smile, strong presence. Side light. Plain mid-grey wall. Black and white photograph.

items.name: DAISUKE NONAKA
items.prompt: 38-year-old man, architect. Short hair, short trimmed beard, olive work jacket. Relaxed half smile, three-quarter view. Warm late-afternoon sun. Old weathered brick warehouse wall behind him. Warm amber color cast.

items.name: RINA ASAKURA
items.prompt: 21-year-old woman, graphic design student. Short wavy brown-black hair, mustard yellow cardigan. Big natural smile, facing the camera. Bright daylight. Blurred saturated orange-to-yellow painted wall behind her.

items.name: HIROSHI KAMIYA
items.prompt: 66-year-old man, product design professor. Receding white hair, round tortoiseshell glasses, white shirt and dark tie. Kind, slightly amused expression. Soft window light. Plain cream wall.

items.name: SAKI TOYODA
items.prompt: 30-year-old woman, jewelry designer. Dark hair in a low bun, sculptural recycled-plastic earrings, black top. Confident gaze at the camera, no smile. Clean flat light. Plain white background.

items.name: KAITO MURAKI
items.prompt: 20-year-old man, animation student. Long bangs nearly covering his eyes, dark green sweatshirt, tired but cheerful. Looking at the camera with a small grin. Fluorescent classroom light. Blurred pale wall covered with pinned paper sheets.

items.name: EMI NAKAGIRI
items.prompt: 48-year-old woman, textile lecturer. Shoulder-length hair with some grey strands, indigo-dyed linen blouse. Warm smile, looking to one side. Dappled sunlight outdoors. Blurred green garden leaves behind her.

items.name: SOTA HIRAI
items.prompt: 22-year-old man, sound art student. Short black hair, large headphones resting around his neck, plain black T-shirt. Quiet, neutral expression, profile turned three-quarters away. Dim studio. Dark blue-black gradient background with cool color cast.

items.name: MAI KUBOTA
items.prompt: 35-year-old woman, ceramic artist. Hair wrapped in a plain cotton headscarf, clay-dusted brown work shirt. Soft relaxed smile. Warm light. Blurred rough clay-plaster wall and stacked pottery behind her.

items.name: TAKUMI OSAWA
items.prompt: 21-year-old man, graphic design student. Short spiky hair, bright red T-shirt. Playful expression with raised eyebrows, facing the camera. On-camera flash look. Blurred wall covered in colorful printed posters behind him.

items.name: NORIKO TSUJI
items.prompt: 60-year-old woman, printmaking professor. Silver hair in a neat short cut, black round glasses, black high-neck top. Sharp attentive gaze directly at the camera. Soft studio light. Plain white wall.

items.name: YUTO SEKINE
items.prompt: 36-year-old man, installation artist. Slicked-back black hair, dark jacket. Serious expression, turned slightly from the camera. Standing in a dark gallery with a band of cold blue projected light across part of his face. Almost black background.

items.name: HINA MOCHIZUKI
items.prompt: 20-year-old woman, fashion student. Long hair with a center part, loose undyed canvas smock with visible hand stitching. Calm, dreamy look past the camera. Soft diffused daylight. Blurred sky-blue gradient background.

items.name: MASATO IWASE
items.prompt: 52-year-old man, photographer and lecturer. Weathered sun-tanned face, short salt-and-pepper hair, outdoor vest. Squinting slightly with a small smile. Riverside overcast light. Blurred river bank behind him. Black and white photograph.

items.name: KOTONE AOKI
items.prompt: 21-year-old woman, book design student. Neat black bob with bangs, round glasses, white collared blouse under a grey cardigan. Reserved, slight smile, chin lowered. Soft library light. Blurred pale bookshelves behind her.

items.name: TETSU WAKABAYASHI
items.prompt: 63-year-old man, metal casting professor. Very short grey hair, deep lines in his face, dark work jacket. Stern but kind gaze directly at the camera. Hard side light. Near-black background. Black and white photograph.

items.name: YUNA SAEKI
items.prompt: 29-year-old woman, glass artist. Hair in a loose ponytail with a few strands falling out, plain white T-shirt. Soft smile, looking to the side. Warm honey-colored light from a kiln room. Blurred warm orange glow behind her.

items.name: RENTARO HOSHI
items.prompt: 23-year-old man, interaction design student. Medium-length side-parted hair, thin black-frame glasses, plain light blue shirt. Curious expression, head slightly tilted. Clean soft light. Plain white background.

items.name: CHIHIRO UENO
items.prompt: 34-year-old woman, painter. Hair pulled up in a messy knot, faint paint marks on her cheek, loose black shirt. Calm direct gaze at the camera, no smile. Soft north light. Blurred grey-white studio wall with paint marks behind her.

items.name: GENKI ARAI
items.prompt: 20-year-old man, woodworking student. Buzz cut, broad cheerful open-mouth smile, navy work shirt with sawdust on it. Facing the camera. Warm workshop light. Blurred stacked timber behind him.

items.name: SHIORI KONDO
items.prompt: 46-year-old woman, type designer and lecturer. Straight chin-length hair tucked behind one ear, charcoal blazer over a white top. Gentle precise smile, three-quarter view. Soft window light. Plain off-white wall.
